title: My timeline sheet with three boxes
subject: History
unit: Spring 2: Childhood within living memory (Memory Box)
source: Written for history/y1 lesson 2 (My timeline sheet with three boxes (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 2: My own timeline. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

keywords.def: a line that shows things in time order
a small child learning to walk

questions.q: Put in order: child, baby, toddler.
Finish: Before I could walk, I ...

questions.a: For example: read, run, say Al-Fatihah

questions.q: Core: Draw three things on your timeline: a baby bottle, small shoes, your school bag. Write baby, toddler, now.
questions.a: Three pictures in order with labels
For example: Now I can ride a bike

questions.q: Stretch: What will you be able to do next year?

questions.a: B) Baby. We are babies first, then toddlers, then children.

questions.q: Big question: how have you changed since you were a baby?
questions.a: For example: I am taller and I can talk, read and pray
